axis: per-print CPI axis (PLAN_forex_v5.md section 2, axis 1) — within-bloc per-print timing structure

mechanism.name: availability-exact post-print reaction-direction drift
mechanism.statement: When a domestic CPI print of the non-US leg becomes evidenced-available, take the local pair in the direction of the print-window reaction and hold a fixed horizon: the reaction R = close(first 16:00 America/New_York bar strictly AFTER the print's available_time_utc) / close(last 16:00 America/New_York bar strictly BEFORE available_time_utc) - 1 defines the direction; the decision is taken at that first-after bar (strictly after availability by construction) and the position is filled at the NEXT 16:00-NY bar, held H sessions. One round trip per evidenced print; overlapping holds are booked as independent round trips (event-basket convention); no netting.

mechanism_before_parameter.who_is_forced_or_slow: A domestic CPI print is a lump arrival of public information about the local policy-rate path. Fast systematic participants reprice the local currency within the release session; reserve managers, corporate hedgers and slower discretionary/CTA money adjust exposures over multiple sessions because their mandates re-balance on review cycles, not on release seconds.
mechanism_before_parameter.why_the_effect_exists: If the release-session repricing only partially diffuses the print's rate-path content, the residual adjustment appears as multi-session drift in the direction of the release-window move. The effect must live ONLY at evidenced print dates: between prints there is no new inflation information and the drift claim makes no prediction.
mechanism_before_parameter.observable: The sign of the availability-exact print-window close-to-close return of the local pair, computed from the authorized price snapshots and the evidenced clock stamps only. No CPI value, no surprise estimate, no US leg, no policy-rate input anywhere in the signal.
mechanism_before_parameter.when_it_must_fail: If release-session repricing is complete before the daily fill (fast-money efficiency), if the reaction sign is noise (no persistent component), if the next-session fill gap (24h) forfeits the drift, or if the frozen cost ladder (3.0 bps round trip at stress tier 2.0) exceeds the per-trade drift. Failure on any of these is a correct REJECT, not a defect of the test.
mechanism_before_parameter.control_that_kills_the_convenient_explan: A matched non-print-day placebo running the IDENTICAL reaction-and-hold rule at windows containing no evidenced print: if generic daily momentum of the same shape earns the anchor's expectancy, the placebo reproduces the anchor and the per-print mechanism claim dies regardless of anchor profitability (the V2-family2 lesson, HYPOTHESIS_LEDGER E.2).

universe.justification: Evidence-dictated subset, not preference. p0a_cpi_availability_table.json: per_print_axis_eligible = true for GB, CA, AU, NZ only; US is UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED (BLS anti-bot 403, archived), so NO pair has an evidenced US CPI leg; EMU is DATA_YES_TIMING_NO (EURUSD), JP FORWARD_SCHEDULE_ONLY (USDJPY), CH UNEVIDENCED (USDCHF). The four traded pairs are exactly the pairs whose NON-US leg has evidenced per-print clocks; the three excluded pairs have no evidenced leg at all. Pair concentration risk from the uneven event counts (CA 105 / GB 88 / NZ 30 / AU 23) is disclosed in margin_to_fail_expectations and probed by the frozen drop-one suite, never by pair-dropping.

conditioning_clock_source.per_row_integrity: every clock carries decision_date, available_time_utc, precision, reference_period, archive_sha256; no clock outside this file is ever used; clocks are consumed verbatim (no schedule inference, no seasonality imputation, no asserted bounds)
conditioning_clock_source.availability_lag_rule: a decision at a 16:00 America/New_York bar may condition on a print iff the bar's instant is strictly AFTER the print's available_time_utc parsed with its recorded offset. Consequences locked per economy: CA (INSTANT, 97 stamps at 08:30:00Z plus 8 off-schedule intraday stamps — all before the same-day 16:00-NY bar): first eligible decision is the SAME calendar day's 16:00-NY bar. NZ (INSTANT 10:45:45 with +12:00/+13:00 offsets, i.e. the instant falls on the previous UTC day): first eligible decision is the 16:00-NY bar of the NZ release calendar date. GB and AU (DAY precision, available_time_utc = decision_date 23:59:59Z, AFTER the same-day NY close): first eligible decision is the NEXT trading day's 16:00-NY bar — the availability lag is structural for GB/AU and is never shortened.
conditioning_clock_source.gap_fail_closed: AU: only the 23 evidenced clocks exist (documented archive gaps — pre-Sep-2019 quarterlies and mid-2022 rows absent from official sources). Any month without an evidenced AU clock produces NO AUDUSD decision. No trade is ever manufactured from an unevidenced release date.

decision_clock: DAILY, the completed 16:00 America/New_York bar (20:00Z EDT / 21:00Z EST), DST-aware; one decision event per evidenced print per pair; daily-or-slower satisfied
warmup: Feature warmup: 2 daily bars per pair (a reaction needs one prior close; the second bar guards the empty-window edge). Fold scaffolding inherited frozen from the V3 scored runner: warmup region before 2020-03-01T00:00:00Z, PURGE_DAYS = 14, internal boundaries 2022-05-01 and 2024-08-01; pre-fold decisions execute and score in no fold per frozen fold_of(); fold-boundary positions are force-flattened at the boundary's last NY bar and attributed to the entry fold; trades spanning an internal boundary are refused (FOLD_FORCE_FLAT_VIOLATION). Expected scored-region event counts (S0 events after the fold-0 purge): GB ~65, CA ~80, NZ ~21, AU ~23 — anchor book order ~190 round trips against the frozen per-arm floor of 40 decisions.
features_and_lags: print-window reaction R_i = P(first 16:00-NY trading bar strictly after available_time_utc of print i) / P(last 16:00-NY trading bar strictly before available_time_utc of print i) - 1, on pair i's own close series; no other feature exists
direction = sign(R_i); positions entered from flat only

lag discipline: the decision instant is the first-after bar itself; the fill is the NEXT 16:00-NY trading bar; every input to the decision (both closes) is observed strictly before the fill instant — one-event-lag clean by construction
no rolling statistics, no volatility, no thresholds, no CPI values, no cross-pair inputs: the feature set is a single sign per evidenced print

entry_exit_fill_conventions.entry: at the next 16:00-NY trading bar after the decision bar, full unit notional 10000 USD-units, direction sign(R)
entry_exit_fill_conventions.exit: at the 16:00-NY trading bar exactly H sessions after the entry bar (H = 5 anchor; session = trading bar, weekends/holidays skipped by the authorized calendar)
entry_exit_fill_conventions.fills: next-bar fills on 16:00 America/New_York DST calendar per frozen runner convention; decision-to-entry gap is exactly one session (1-4 calendar days across weekends); same-bar fills are structurally impossible
entry_exit_fill_conventions.weekend_gate: an entry landing on the Friday 16:00-NY week-close boundary is dropped fail-closed and recorded in weekend_gate_dropped; the print is NOT re-anchored to a later day (no substitution, event fidelity preserved); exits at the Friday boundary bar are legitimate closes (frozen d3-fixture convention)
entry_exit_fill_conventions.overlap: round trips from different prints may overlap; each is booked independently; flat is the absence of a round trip, never a side-0 position
entry_exit_fill_conventions.dual_book: price-only and financing-adjusted columns kept separate and immutable per the frozen kernel; financing adjustments carried by the family under the frozen V3_FROZEN_POLICY_RATE_CARRY formula (the SIGNAL has zero rate content; financing touches only the second book); the price-only sign is never inverted and FINANCING_MANUFACTURES_EDGE remains binding

costs.schedule: cost = notional * (1.5 bps * tier) / 10000 charged once per fill side; notional 10000 USD-units; tiers {1.0, 1.5, 2.0}; costs never softened
costs.stress_primary: tier 2.0 (3.0 bps per side, 6.0 bps round trip) is the primary survival gate; tier books re-price every fill at the tier cost on BOOKED PnL (F1-fixed convention); stress rows pairwise distinct, fail-closed on collision
costs.break_even_reporting: break-even bps per cell from the same kernel, reported at all three tiers; a cell whose tier-2.0 break-even exceeds the per-trade gross move is reported as cost-dominated

anchor.spec: The mechanism exactly: availability-exact reaction sign, next-bar fill, hold H = 5 sessions, 4-pair evidence-dictated universe, 246-clock conditioning file.

neighbour.spec: Identical machinery with hold H = 10 sessions.
neighbour.why_genuine_variant: It varies only the diffusion horizon of THIS mechanism. If print-window direction carries multi-session content, the longer hold should retain positive expectancy; if the drift is a 1-2 session microstructure artifact that H=5 already barely catches, the neighbour dies with the anchor.

causal_placebo_control.spec: Matched non-print-day placebo: for each evidenced print, run the identical reaction-and-hold rule anchored at the first trading day at least 35 calendar days AFTER the print's availability that lies outside +/-5 sessions of every evidenced print of that economy; identical hold, fills, notional, costs, dual books, fold handling. The control book has, by construction, no print-window exposure.
causal_placebo_control.fires_differently_how: Its anchor days are ordinary days: the same weekday-of-month, the same calendar density, but no release-window information. Where the anchor's reactions cluster around high-volatility release weeks, the placebo reacts to ordinary daily noise.
causal_placebo_control.runs_to_completion_proof: Its fills use the same next-bar convention on the same calendar with no conditioning dependency beyond the same clock file; nothing in the control can be refused by the frozen validator (the V3R ONE_EVENT_LAG lesson: a control that cannot execute has null evidentiary value).
causal_placebo_control.preregistered_rejection_rule: CONTROL_REPRODUCES_MECHANISM if control financing-adjusted expectancy > 0 AND control PF >= 1.10: the drift then belongs to generic daily momentum of this shape, not to per-print structure, and the family is falsified regardless of anchor PnL.

arms_note: Exactly three scored arms (anchor, neighbour, control) per family per the frozen structure mandate. The runner-required benchmark_treatment book (V3-I convention, not a scored cell) is the same sign rule applied unconditionally: daily close-to-close sign, hold 5, identical fills/costs — the conditioning-removed twin against which incremental alpha is computed per the frozen per_trade_expectancy_difference convention.

preregistered: F1 placebo: control_nonprint_placebo financing-adjusted expectancy > 0 AND PF >= 1.10 (CONTROL_REPRODUCES_MECHANISM) -> the measured drift is not print-specific -> family falsified whatever the anchor earns.
F2 costs: STRESS_TIER_2.0 gate fails (tier-2.0 booked PnL non-positive or PF < 1.00) -> the per-print drift does not clear the stressed cost ladder -> REJECT.

F3 gates: any frozen Stage-A failure (EXPECTANCY_NONPOSITIVE, PF_BELOW_1.10, FEWER_THAN_2_POSITIVE_POPULATED_FOLDS, POPULATED_FOLD_PF_BELOW_0.80, MDD_ABOVE_FROZEN_CEILING, POSITIVE_FOLD_SHARE_ABOVE_50PCT, PAIR_CONCENTRATION_ABOVE_40PCT, STRESS_TIER_1.5_FAIL, DROPOUT_SURVIVAL_BELOW_6_OF_8, USD_DRIFT_EXPLAINS_ANCHOR |corr| > 0.30, DECISION_FLOOR_NOT_MET, INCREMENTAL_ALPHA_NOT_POSITIVE, FINANCING_MANUFACTURES_EDGE) -> REJECT with per-gate margins recorded (P-2); no threshold weakening, no rescue.
F4 sample: per-arm decisions below the frozen floor of 40 records SAMPLE_FLOOR_FAIL and is terminal for the family; never rescored with relaxed floors.
falsification_rule.expected_failure_interpretation: A REJECT here is a first-class scientific outcome, expected ex ante to be the modal one: release-session direction is plausibly fully priced by the daily fill, and the modal falsification path is F1 (placebo reproduces anchor — drift is generic momentum) or F2 (drift thinner than the stressed ladder). A base-tier knife-edge pass would be recorded as such with per-gate margins and would still have to survive F1-F4. Nothing in this packet may be re-tuned after any outcome is visible.

class_adjacency_disclosure: This proposal is ADJACENT to the pre-registered DATA_BLOCKED_VALID classes (real-differential, PPP-deviation) but does not implement, proxy, or rescue them: it uses NO US leg (unevidenced), NO CPI levels or revisions, NO bilateral price levels, and no real or nominal differential — its only information source is the evidenced per-print release TIMING structure and the within-bloc price reaction to it. The two pre-registered classes carry forward as DATA_BLOCKED_VALID (US leg unevidenced per p0_verdict.json) and are NOT proposed in this packet; they remain selectable the moment their availability evidence is wired under a future owner decision.
ancestry_disclosure: Nearest forbidden ancestry for the D2 novelty check: FXFV4-A6-P1 commodity-bloc risk-off event basket (event-conditioned entries with a fixed hold — same gross SHAPE, different conditioning information: official inflation print dates vs risk-off event days; different sign logic: local reaction direction vs risk-off direction) and FXFV1-A3-P1 session momentum (momentum continuation label, different clock entirely: intraday session-open vs daily post-print). Both proposals accept measured |rho| <= 0.20 adjudication against ALL forbidden ancestry at D2; prose distinctions are not the test, the rho numbers are. No session/open structure, no carry/financing direction, no policy-rate input exists in this signal.

likely_fail: EXPECTANCY_NONPOSITIVE / PF_BELOW_1.10 — event effects of this class are small; the modal outcome
STRESS_TIER_2.0 — 6.0 bps stressed round trip vs a per-trade drift plausibly under 10 bps
INCREMENTAL_ALPHA_NOT_POSITIVE — unconditional daily momentum of the same horizon is a demanding benchmark for an event subset

PAIR_CONCENTRATION_ABOVE_40PCT — CA (105) + GB (88) are 78% of events; if CA alone contributes > 40% of gross positive PnL the gate fires; universe is fixed by evidence, risk disclosed, drop-one suite probes it
moderate_risk: USD_DRIFT_EXPLAINS_ANCHOR — all four pairs are USD crosses; the sign rule is not structurally USD-short or USD-long, but 2021-2022 USD trend overlap is real
fold-population of AU/NZ in fold 2 (2024-08 onward: ~3 and ~4 events) — book-level fold gates evaluate the pooled book, but per-fold sparsity widens the fold-positive-share margin
expected_clean_pass: MDD_ABOVE_FROZEN_CEILING low risk at 10000-unit notionals (a 1% adverse move costs 100 USD against the 2500 USD ceiling)
reproduction ALL_MATCH (deterministic rule, no inferred stamps)
